title.zh: 欧姆定律与串并联电路

clips.send: Keep both bulbs identical and compare the voltage across one bulb in each layout. This model uses an ideal battery and ideal meters. It treats bulbs as fixed resistances and uses electrical power to represent brightness. The next lab models a filament that heats up.
clips.text: Keep both bulbs identical and compare the voltage across one bulb in each layout. This model uses an ideal battery and ideal meters. It treats bulbs as fixed resistances and uses electrical power to represent brightness. The next lab models a filament that heats up.

clips.send: Ohm’s law is written I equals U/R. At constant resistance, current is proportional to voltage. At a fixed voltage, current is inversely proportional to resistance. A bulb’s filament usually gets hotter as the voltage rises, so its resistance increases. The dashed curve is an illustrative model.

clips.send: Change one variable at a time. For the same metal and temperature, a longer wire of the same thickness has more resistance. For wires of the same length, a larger cross-sectional area gives less resistance. In this model’s temperature range, copper and tungsten wires both gain resistance as they warm.

clips.send: Wire the circuit with the switch open. Put the ammeter in series with the test resistor and connect the voltmeter across it. Connect each meter’s positive terminal on the battery’s positive side and choose a suitable range. Set the rheostat to its maximum connected resistance before closing the switch.

clips.send: 欧姆定律写作 I 等于 U/R。电阻一定时，电流与电压成正比；电压一定时，电流与电阻成反比。小灯泡的电压升高时，灯丝通常会变热，电阻随之增大。虚线是示意模型。
clips.text: 欧姆定律写作 I = U/R。电阻一定时，电流与电压成正比；电压一定时，电流与电阻成反比。小灯泡的电压升高时，灯丝通常会变热，电阻随之增大。虚线是示意模型。

clips.send: 接线时断开开关。电流表与待测电阻串联，电压表并联在待测电阻两端。两只电表的正接线柱接靠近电源正极的一侧，并选用合适的量程。闭合开关前，将滑动变阻器接入电路的阻值调到最大。
clips.text: 接线时断开开关。电流表与待测电阻串联，电压表并联在待测电阻两端。两只电表的正接线柱接靠近电源正极的一侧，并选用合适的量程。闭合开关前，将滑动变阻器接入电路的阻值调到最大。

clips.send: 先用两个相同的灯泡，比较串联和并联时同一个灯泡两端的电压。模型中电池和电表均为理想元件，灯泡用定值电阻近似，亮度用电功率表示。下一节用曲线模拟灯丝升温后的变化。

clips.send: 用控制变量法，每次只改变一个因素。同种材料、同一温度下，横截面积相同时，导线越长，电阻越大；长度相同时，横截面积越大，电阻越小。在图示温度范围内，铜线和钨丝的电阻都随温度升高而增大。
